item.title: An SMTP black hole for unit tests
item.author: team@silocitylabs.com (Silo City Labs)
item.description: A test that sends mail needs somewhere for the message to land. fakeemaildomain.com is that place: a public mail exchanger that accepts the envelope, replies on purpose, and discards the body. The site has no signup, no inbox, and no forwarding.
